result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: truncated text in the restaurant listing and an incomplete card at the bottom of the page that is cut off.

issues.description: Third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' section is truncated - displays 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of full name
issues.suggestion: Adjust text overflow handling to either show full name on single line, use ellipsis properly, or allow text wrapping to display complete restaurant name

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (with -20% discount badge) is cut off at the bottom of the page - restaurant name and delivery details are not visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure the complete card including restaurant name and delivery information is visible before the page ends, or adjust spacing/padding to prevent content cutoff
